title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Le Chéile: Together for an inclusive better world‘ project in Central and West Africa, implemented by Sightsavers Ireland, aims to strengthen education, eye health and governance systems sustainably, so that targeted populations can claim their rights to healthcare and education, and contribute to decisions that affect their lives. The objective is to ensure eye health service delivery in Liberia includes specific gender and disability focus so that all people can access the services they need. The key activities include training health workers at a range of professional levels on disability awareness, gender equality and inclusion, and strengthening the targeting process and implementation of age, gender and disability data disaggregation strategies across health facilities and reporting systems.
